# Doomgeneric source for the cooperative CiukiOS port

Pinned upstream commit and archive hash are recorded in `UPSTREAM.json`.
The complete corresponding upstream source archive and GPL license are kept
here. CiukiOS changes are in `src/ports/doomgeneric/` and reproducible build
orchestration is `scripts/build_doom_window.py`.

This is a separately compiled, initially silent source port for the explicit
Ciuki graphics bridge. It is not an emulator or a replacement for the existing
fullscreen Doom/audio executables. No WAD/game data is included in this source
package. Preserve the upstream and per-file copyright/license notices when
distributing the binary together with its corresponding modified sources.
